messages:
alex: Quick sync — planning to cut release/v2.3 at 18:00 UTC today. Need version bump, changelog nudge, SDK docs regen, and docsite deploy before cutoff. Can people confirm?
marie: I can handle the changelog nudge and PR review for any last-minute entries. Will post a checklist soon.
alex: thanks marie. main asks: bump package versions (python/js), verify changelog, merge release branch into main, tag rc.
sahil: I can do the python/packaging bump and tag. Will open 1-2 small PRs. ETA 16:15 UTC.
jordan: I will regen SDK docs after the final tag — heads up commands below, do not run until PRs merged.
---
```bash
# regen SDK docs (javascript)
git checkout release/v2.3
make gen-sdk-docs-js
git add docs/sdk/js && git commit -m "chore(docs): regen sdk js docs for v2.3-rc"
```
---
lina: console change landed in #4382 but still behind flag. We need to flip the flag for canary once docs are live so screenshots and routes match. Can someone coordinate the flip window?
marie: I'll coordinate the console flag toggle with product — aiming for a 30min canary after docs deploy. I'll ping @product on the timeline.
sahil: tagging the release PRs here: python bump -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4590, js bump -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4591
alex: perfect. After merges, jordan or docs-bot run the deploy. docs-bot you good to kick off the Netlify deploy?
docs-bot: sure — I can trigger the docsite build once you post the final tag. Use `/docs deploy v2.3-rc.1` in this thread to start.
jordan: will wait for the tag. After deploy, I'll run a quick smoke: routes, code samples, and SDK download links. If anything fails, revert flag and hold the cut.
alex: cutoff reminder: no major API changes after 16:30 UTC. Small doc tweaks ok until 17:40 UTC. Branch cut at 18:00 UTC.
marie: noted. I'll post a changelog sanity checklist: items to confirm -> deprecations, config changes, migration notes, examples updated.
sahil: tag created -> v2.3-rc.1. PRs merged.
docs-bot: /docs deploy v2.3-rc.1
deploy-bot: docs deploy queued on netlify-region-1, build id 98f3a. Canary window scheduled 18:30-19:00 UTC.
jordan: smoke passed for main pages and SDK download links. One minor table formatting edge on integrations page — pushing a hotfix doc PR now.
marie: thanks — if the hotfix lands before 18:00 I'll merge, otherwise we'll patch post-release.
alex: thanks everyone — tagging this as cut-ready. Will send release notes draft after canary. :tada:
